view_title: Column grid master for บ้านครอบครัวไทยร่วมสมัย 6 -- named grid from S-02 (แปลนฐานรากแผ่/แปลนฐานรากแบบตอกเข็ม, PNG 19 / printed 17), dummy grids from S-03 (แปลนคาน พื้นชั้นล่าง, PNG 20) with printed positions confirmed on A-04 (แปลนพื้นชั้น 1, PNG 06) and S-04 (แปลนอะเส, PNG 21). 3 x 4 named grid, 7.00 m x 9.50 m overall.

x_lines.source: A-04 top sub-chain 2.55/1.45 (= 4.00). Line carries beam B1 (S-03, C..B) under the ห้องน้ำ WC1 east wall. No printed dimension for it on S-03 itself.
A-04 bottom chain 3.55/0.45 (= 4.00) under จอดรถ. Line carries vertical beam B2 (S-03, B..A) = east edge of the carport; the carport SO slab edge continues on this line down to 12.50.

S-03 prints 0.60 east of grid 3 (below row B); S-04 อะเส plan prints the same 0.60; A-04 top sub-chain 0.60/0.90 (= 1.50). Line carries B4X end points (rows C and B), vertical edge beam B2 (C..B), 2 CN posts, and at +3.75 the B1 กันสาด beams (S-04).

y_lines.source: A-04 left sub-chain 2.90/1.10 (= 4.00), re-confirmed by a second printed 1.10 inside the plan at grid 3 (นอน2 south wall to C). Line carries the mid-bay beam B2 (S-03, spans 2..3 between D and C, bearing on B5 and B3) under the นอน2/ห้องน้ำ south wall. Pixel measurement of the beam centreline = 2.905 m, dead on the printed 2.90.

S-03 left extension chain 1.50/1.50 (= 3.00 below A); A-04 prints the same 1.50 at the เฉลียง. Line carries beam B3 (A'-2..A'-3, solid) closing the porch frame, and the lower ends of dashed beams B5X (grid 2) and B3X (grid 3).

dummy_grid_rule_check.prime_ordering: x gap 1..2 holds TWO dummy lines -- first real case of the §4 same-gap rule since it was written (spec §12 listed it as untested). Scanned left to right: 1' (2.55) before 1'' (3.55) -- single prime correctly on the left line. All other dummies are alone in their gaps.
dummy_grid_rule_check.negative_pos_m: NOT TRIGGERED -- nothing structural was found left of grid 1 or above grid D on any sheet read (S-02/S-03/S-04/A-04). The carport slab west edge scales to ~0.10 m west of grid 1 but is a slab-only edge (no beam, no column), so no negative dummy grid was created.

non_grid_dimensions_do_not_confuse.location: east of grid 3, ground slab (S-03 top chain '1.50', A-04 '0.60 + 0.90')
non_grid_dimensions_do_not_confuse.meaning: east edge of the ชักล้าง SO slab at 8.50 m -- SINGLE thin line on S-03 from D to C, no beam, no columns at its corners. Slab-only edge per §4 -> no dummy grid. The structural line east of grid 3 is 3' at 7.60 (0.60), not this 1.50.

non_grid_dimensions_do_not_confuse.location: south of grid A, carport (S-03 left chain second '1.50', total 3.00)
non_grid_dimensions_do_not_confuse.meaning: south edge of the จอดรถ SO slab at 12.50 m (A + 3.00) -- single thin line, no beam, no columns. Slab-only edge -> no dummy grid. (Contrast house 01, where a same-position A'' line was recorded as a low-confidence dummy before the slab-only rule existed; here the drawing clearly shows no beam.)

non_grid_dimensions_do_not_confuse.location: all four sides, roof (S-04 แปลนโครงหลังคา and A-04 แปลนหลังคา chains)
non_grid_dimensions_do_not_confuse.meaning: 1.00 m roof eave overhang beyond grids 1/3/D/A -- rafter free ends only, no beam or post on the eave line -> no dummy grid (§4 explicitly excludes eave edges).

non_grid_dimensions_do_not_confuse.location: south of grid A, กันสาด ค.ส.ล. (S-04 อะเส plan left chain '1.10')
non_grid_dimensions_do_not_confuse.meaning: dashed extent of the +3.75 concrete canopy slab (SX) south of row A, cantilevered from the B6+3.75 beams on row A -- slab edge, no beam at the edge line -> no dummy grid. Distinct from the 1.00 roof eave and from the 1.50 porch line A'.

non_grid_dimensions_do_not_confuse.location: ridge line (S-04 แปลนอะเส '0.50' twice + '0.50' from C; แปลนโครงหลังคา ridge)
non_grid_dimensions_do_not_confuse.meaning: the hip-roof ridge (อกไก่) runs along x = 3.50 m (= grid 2 - 0.50, the roof centreline incl. 1.00 eaves) from y = 3.50 (C - 0.50) to y = 6.00 (row B). Two CX posts support it (one on a 0.50 m B2 stub off the grid-2 อะเส, one on the row-B อะเส). DECISION: no dummy grid -- an isolated 2.50 m roof member + 2 posts locatable by printed 0.50 offsets (house-07 precedent: off-grid point elements carried by offset_note, e.g. its ~A-3 F1 pad). Every other member on every sheet ignores this line.

non_grid_dimensions_do_not_confuse.location: west side, bathroom 2 step (A-04 left chain '0.60' below B)
non_grid_dimensions_do_not_confuse.meaning: 0.60 m strip at the ห้องน้ำ (+0.50) door / +0.40 step south of row B -- wall/step on slab, no beam on S-03 there -> no dummy grid.

warnings: BOTH DIMENSION CHAINS CLOSE. x: printed sub-chain 4.00 + 3.00 = 7.00 equals the printed overall 7.00 (verified on S-02 both views, S-03, S-04 both views, A-04 both views). y: printed sub-chain 4.00 + 2.00 + 3.50 = 9.50 equals the printed overall 9.50 (same sheets). Pixel verification: every span measures at one uniform scale (78.7 px/m) on S-02 and S-03 -- tick coordinates x 1360.5/1675.5/1911.5, y 733/1048/1205.5/1481 -- so no span is drawn compressed.

NO DRAWING BREAK LINES anywhere in this set. Checked explicitly per the house-06 lesson: every dimension chain on S-02/S-03/S-04/A-04 was cropped tight and read at 4-6x zoom (both chains, including the mid-line stretches where house 06 hid its zigzag) -- all lines are continuous, and the uniform pixel scale above independently rules out a hidden compressed span. This is a clean CAD set (2559/2016, กรมโยธาธิการและผังเมือง S59029/AR58179).

GRID SOURCE PRECEDENCE: named grid taken from S-02 (structural footing plans, cleanest read, 12 footings on 12 intersections in both foundation systems). A-03 (ผังบริเวณ, PNG 05) self-declares 'เป็นเพียงตัวอย่างเพื่อประมาณราคา' and per the README precedence rule was NOT used for grid geometry; its 11.70/14.60 site dimensions are lot/siting numbers, not this grid's closure target.

REVERSAL of the Stage-0 manifest reading (recording it per the rewrite rule): Stage 0 said 'x-axis +1.50 m beyond grid 3 ... beams B4X/CN bear on these extension points'. Wrong at high zoom. The +1.50 line is the ชักล้าง slab edge -- a single thin line, no beam, no posts. B4X, the east edge beam B2 and both CN posts sit at +0.60 (printed on S-03, S-04 AND A-04), so the dummy grid is 3' = 7.60, and 8.50 gets no grid line. The y-extension half of the Stage-0 note was right: A' = 11.00 carries real beams (B3/B5X/B3X); but A'' = 12.50 is the carport slab-only edge and gets no grid line either.

Stage-0 open question 'check S-05/S-06 for a footing at the extension points' -- RESOLVED: S-05 (PNG 22) holds only F1.30x1.30/F1.60x1.60 spread-footing details, S-06 (PNG 23) only F5/F9 pile-cap details. No footing exists at 3' or A'. The CN posts (เสาเอ็น) bear on the B4X beam ends, and the porch frame B5X/B3X/B3(A') cantilevers off the row-A columns -- consistent with S-02 showing footings only on the 12 named intersections.

Stage-0 open question 'S-04 roof 1.00 m eave overhang: dummy-grid-worthy?' -- RESOLVED: no. The 1.00 m lines on S-04 แปลนโครงหลังคา and A-04 แปลนหลังคา are rafter free ends; the roof's bearing lines are the named grids where the B2 อะเส sit. No roof member ends on a line that lacks a grid name (the ridge/CX system is handled by printed 0.50 offsets -- see non_grid_dimensions entry).

Interior dummy lines 1', 1'', D' have their positions printed only on A-04 (architectural), not on S-03 itself. Per the op1 precedence rules the S-sheets win on GRID GEOMETRY, but S-03 prints no number at all for these three lines, so the A-04 dimensions are the only printed source -- used as-is, and each matches the S-03 beam pixel position to within 0.10 m (D' and 1'' exactly; 1' printed 2.55 = beam west face, centre ~2.65, flagged on the line entry).
Only ONE building in this set (Stage 0 confirmed, §11a not applicable) -- this single grid master covers everything; no lettered second grid file exists.
